title: 2026 UK ETS free-allocation cross-sectoral correction factor QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS Allocation Table for operators of installations

facts.source_fact: The cross-sectoral correction factor applies when total free allowances exceed the industry cap.
The industry cap is the share of the total cap set aside for free allocation.
If the CSCF is triggered in 2026, the Authority intends mitigation through allowance reserves.
Free allocation is intended to reduce carbon-leakage risk.
The 2021-2026 Allocation Table lists installation free allocations.
The table is updated for Activity Level Changes.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat table values as immutable.

facts.source_fact: 2026 is treated as an extension of the current allocation period.
Some 2026 entries can remain under review pending activity-level adjustments.
Free allowances are normally allocated by 28 February unless withheld under regulator instruction.
Scheme allocation values are regulatory entitlements, not measured emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not convert allocation to parcel emissions.
